messages:
Elaine W.: Quick sync — AcmeCloud SI onboarding next week. We need a tight SEV onramp for their support engineers joining ops. Proposal: shared channel + lightweight war room runbook. Thoughts?
Sam K.: +1. Shared channel is good but we need explicit handoff rules: who paged, who joins, expected response SLAs.
Marta R.: Can we reuse the marketplace war-room checklist + a short FAQ for the SI? Less new docs to maintain.
Amar P.: Agree on reusing where possible. One addition: 'cadet' rotation for partner SEs — they shadow first 3 incidents, then take first triage. Helps knowledge transfer.
Nate L.: Love cadet idea. For channels: propose naming convention so it's discoverable and archived: `#partner-<vendor>-sev` and a companion `#partner-<vendor>-ops` for postmortem discussion.
Elaine W.: Nice. Let's lock down channel policy and the handoff message template. I can draft a one-pager. Who owns the partner-side contact list?
Marta R.: I'll own the contact list and verify emails/roles with Acme. Will send a CSV by EOD Tuesday.
Sam K.: Handoff template (draft):
```
ROOT: <who raised> | <severity> | <brief impact>
ACTION: who's bridging (Redwood) | who's bridging (Partner)
JOIN: list of required attendees (oncall, partner cadet, SE)
ESCALATE: next steps if no ack in 5m
POST: link to postmortem doc
```
Nate L.: Add a 'fallback model' line — which model variant/service to fallback to if the partner-integrated path fails (e.g., hosted -> dedicated -> smaller model).
Amar P.: Also add labels for routing: `@redwood-oncall`, `@partner-liaison`, and a short tag to indicate data-sensitivity (P0-P3).
partner-bot: Incident created: 3945678922 — Acme edge routing errors. Channel `#partner-acme-sev` auto-provisioned.
Elaine W.: OK that incident was a good dry-run. Observations: partner cadet joined but didn't post initial triage. Let's add an onboarding checklist: 1) Slack etiquette + templates, 2) quickfire KB links, 3) how to trigger war-room.
Marta R.: I'll add checklist to the shared Confluence page and attach to the invite. Also planning a 30m pre-launch dry-run with Acme SEs — schedule Doodle today.
Sam K.: Operational notes to add to runbook: how to transfer pager ownership if partner takes the lead; how to reconcile billing-impacting incidents; and who closes the war room.
Nate L.: Can we automate a small bot response when the channel is created? E.g., `@partner-bot` posts the template checklist and pins the runbook link. Saves mental overhead.
Amar P.: Yes — partner-bot can do that. Let's also have the bot post a quick 'who is oncadet' message 10m after creation to remind partner SEs to join.
Elaine W.: Great. Action items: Marta will share contacts (by Tue), Sam will finalize template (Wed), Nate to add bot automation (Thu), Amar to prototype cadet rotation doc (Fri). I'll run the dry-run once those are ready.
Marta R.: noted. tagging @Acme folks in the invite once Doodle done. :calendar:
Sam K.: Thanks all — this pattern should generalize to HW partners and SIs. We'll capture any partner-specific exceptions in the partner profile.
Elaine W.: Perfect. Closing loop — will post the final runbook and a short training deck for partner cadets. :thumbsup:
